items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: We had Alphonso Trent, the owner of the band, hired another piano player, a boy named James Sherman, James Sherman joined us and made that tour with us out in -- in Texas.

ctx.x: But this was back in the Roaring '20's, and we played dances in Houston, back in that day, Houston was cut up into wards, 5th Ward and 2nd Ward and the 3rd Ward. I forget the ward we played in, but it was closely -- it was pretty close to downtown Houston, and we would play dances there and we'd have to turn them away. The band was so popular back in those days.

Yes, we played all through that state, in 1928. We had Alphonso Trent, the owner of the band, hired another piano player, a boy named James Sherman, James Sherman joined us and made that tour with us out in -- in Texas. Sherman was the -- he only had nine fingers. He was originally from Philadelphia, and later years he played with the Charioteers. He was the pianist with the Charioteers.
